Shows the checkout request body carrying the forged client total_amount 1000, the 200 'Checkout successful' response, the order history response persisting total_amount 1000, and the failed assertion 'persisted total equals the server-derived cart total (200000)' with 'expected 1000 to equal 200000'. items.description: Canonical FR-08 run, iteration 30 (FR08-AI-031). Top card: POST /api/checkout returns 200 {"message":"Checkout successful","orderId":27}. Bottom card: the post-checkout GET /api/cart read-back still returns [{"id":1,"name":"San pham A","price":100000,"quantity":2}], and the test table shows the failed assertion 'FR08-AI-031 cart is cleared after a successful checkout (FR-08)' with 'expected 1 to equal +0'. Note for the reader: htmlextra attributes pm.sendRequest helper calls to the enclosing item, which is why the Verify card displays the helper cart read-back rather than the order-history call. X-Student-Id 23127179 is visible in the request headers.
